summary: Phase 3 (partial) — Inline CMS editability validation for /catalogo, /planifica-tu-viaje, /contacto, /equipo. All 4 pages render with their data-testids; in TEXT EDIT mode they expose a large set of editable surfaces. PERSIST CHECK on /equipo confirmed PUT /api/text_slots/equipo.hero.title returned 200, value persisted across hard reload, then was reset to original (cleanup). Regressions OK: language switch (es→en→fr) navigates without console errors; /planifica-tu-viaje region selection still triggers reco cards with 'Ver detalle' opening trip in new tab. Contacto step-rail eyebrow/title bug fix verified — slots `contacto.contact.steps.eyebrow` and `contacto.contact.steps.title` now render and are editable.

issues: Date inputs (start_date/end_date) use the browser-native HTML date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a localized shadcn calendar component — date order/format does not respect ES/FR locale and is inconsistent with the rest of the design system. Pre-existing, not introduced by Phase 3, but worth flagging.

action_items: (Optional / pre-existing) Replace native <input type='date'> with shadcn Calendar/DatePicker on /planifica-tu-viaje for consistent locale & visual styling.
Phase 3 in-scope pages PASS — proceed to next phase (QueHacemos, Incentivos, ToursLanding, region pages, leftover Home components).
critical_code_review_comments: EditableText slot wrapper data-testid is only present while textEditMode is ON; after reload (mode OFF) the same node renders as a plain element. Locator-based reload checks need to either re-toggle edit mode or assert via API/text content. Consider exposing data-testid in both modes to simplify e2e/regression scripts (this only affects testability, not UX).
PlanificaTuViajePage exposes 61 editable surfaces — verify per-locale fallback strategy (some FR/EN translations currently fall back to Spanish defaults; not a Phase 3 blocker).
ContactPage previously rendered the 3-step rail eyebrow/title empty due to wrong component — fix verified; ensure other pages don't repeat the <E> vs <ET> mix-up (consider one canonical helper).
seed_data_creation: Edited slot equipo.hero.title (PUT 200), then reset to original empty body via PUT {values:{}} (cleanup confirmed via GET — equipo.hero.title now {}). No residual test data.
